about_the_game:
Battle for It All is a tactical, realistic, and fast-paced first-person shooter that blends modern military combat with sci-fi elements. Designed for both solo and multiplayer experiences, the game delivers intense action with a variety of game modes, deep progression, and competitive ranked play.

Game Features:

  • Skirmish – Quick, high-intensity firefights.

  • Free-For-All – Every player for themselves.

  • Team Death Match – Classic team-based combat.

  • Zombies – Survive against waves of the undead.

  • Domination – Capture and hold objectives.

  • Gun Game – Progress through a series of weapons with each kill.

Grounded Movement & Combat

  • Tactical and realistic mechanics—no over-the-top movement gimmicks.

  • A balance of modern firearms and sci-fi-inspired gadgets for strategic depth.

Progression & Customization

  • Earn XP and level up through a skill-based and XP-driven unlock system.

  • Unlock new weapons, perks, and character customization options.

  • Fully ranked modes for every game type—climb the leaderboards in competitive play.

🟢 Regular Updates & Community-Driven Evolution

  • Monthly updates with new content, balance changes, and improvements.

  • A continuously evolving game shaped by player feedback.

With a focus on competitive gameplay, rewarding progression, and tactical gunfights, Battle for It All delivers an FPS experience designed for both hardcore and casual players.

Are you ready to take on the fight?
